findings.root_cause: RC3 validates the full selected-output-to-robustness-to-Claim-to-handoff contract only after formal attempts are captured and sealed; it exposes no reusable pre-run structural probe and execute accepts a shallow candidate/status identity.
findings.proposed_skill_change: Add one generic selected-output contract validator, expose a preflight-output command for a non-result contract probe before experiment freeze, and reuse the validator inside execute for every successful output.
findings.risk_of_overfitting: LOW: required fields and shapes are architecture-level and contain no year, problem title, attachment, entity, field name, model family, parameter or answer.
findings.neutral_test: Generic prediction and optimization probes pass; removing each required downstream field, using a nonfinite metric, empty requirement Claims, malformed perturbations, or missing figure/uncertainty/limitation evidence blocks before a formal Run; execute applies the same validator.
findings.expected_cross_case_benefit: Prevents late evidence loss across descriptive classification, constrained optimization and prediction-to-decision C problems while preserving fail-closed semantics.
findings.maintenance_cost: LOW: one validator, one CLI route, one workflow instruction and focused fault tests.

findings.root_cause: The frozen naive greedy baseline could not construct a feasible minimum supplier set for either seed.
findings.proposed_skill_change: NONE; keep the existing mandatory successful-baseline Gate and design a feasible baseline in the Development regression.
findings.risk_of_overfitting: HIGH if a particular supplier-selection heuristic were embedded in the Skill.
findings.neutral_test: Existing comparison tests continue to reject zero-success baselines and exclude failed attempts from ranking.
findings.expected_cross_case_benefit: Existing Gate already supplies the general benefit without new instructions.

findings.root_cause: Because the baseline failed, the first run never authorized the single post-selection test access required by the frozen comparison contract.
findings.proposed_skill_change: NONE; do not weaken the test-access Gate or invent test evidence after a failed comparison.
findings.risk_of_overfitting: HIGH if authorization were inferred from problem-specific circumstances.
findings.neutral_test: Existing leakage tests continue to reject zero, early, repeated or selection-used test access under the formal comparison path.

findings.root_cause: Only sparse apparent within-object paired observations are available for reversing an observational transformation, so the inverse is not identifiable without an exchangeability assumption.
findings.proposed_skill_change: NONE; preserve the explicit uncertainty and avoid encoding a domain-specific inverse model.
findings.neutral_test: NON_TESTABLE from the other batch cases; retained as a limitation and cannot support positive release.

findings.root_cause: A perfect score on a small grouped validation split is not, by itself, external-validity evidence; the alternative published portfolio also reports very high in-sample discrimination.
findings.proposed_skill_change: NONE; RC3 already requires bounded claims, uncertainty and robustness, and the terminal output-contract failure prevented promotion.
findings.neutral_test: NON_TESTABLE as a universal threshold without inventing a domain/sample-size rule.

findings.root_cause: Published analyses chose different model families, but method-name agreement is not an acceptance criterion and the references are not mathematical or experimental oracles.
findings.proposed_skill_change: NONE; preserve portfolio freedom and judge requirement coverage, mathematics, execution and evidence.
findings.risk_of_overfitting: CRITICAL if reference model names were embedded in the Skill.
findings.neutral_test: Anti-hardcoding scan rejects years, titles, attachment names, entity names, reference formulas and fixed case-specific model portfolios.
findings.expected_cross_case_benefit: Avoids reference imitation and case memorization.
